```python
class WindowSpace:
    def __init__(self, job):
        fields = job['fields']
        self.field_names = [f['name'] for f in fields]
        self.field_domains = [list(f['domain']) for f in fields]
        self.slots = int(job['slots'])
        self.nf = len(fields)
        self.cells = self.slots*self.nf
        self.cell_field = [fi for _ in range(self.slots) for fi in range(self.nf)]
        self.radices = [len(self.field_domains[fi]) for fi in self.cell_field]
        size = 1
        for r in self.radices: size *= r
        self.size = size
        mult = [0]*self.cells; acc=1
        for c in range(self.cells-1,-1,-1): mult[c]=acc; acc*=self.radices[c]
        self.multipliers = mult
        idx = np.arange(size, dtype=np.int64)
        self.universe = np.empty((size, self.cells), dtype=np.int64)
        for c in range(self.cells):
            dom = np.asarray(self.field_domains[self.cell_field[c]], dtype=np.int64)
            self.universe[:, c] = dom[(idx // mult[c]) % self.radices[c]]
        self.domain_arrays = [np.asarray(d, dtype=np.int64) for d in self.field_domains]
```
